title: Ready Position Reset (Michelle Grogan)
style: sung pop coaching cadence 104 bpm bright acoustic strum tight kick clean snare hand claps light Spanish phrase accent encouraging tone pickleball training song artist Michelle Grogan
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Paddle up chest tall eyes ahead
Knees soft heels light feet spread
Every point begins the same
Ready position is the name of the game

[Pre-Chorus]
Reset reset reset
Between every point don't forget

[Chorus]
Ready position reset
Paddle high knees bent the safest bet
Breath in breath out no regret
Ready position reset

[Verse 2]
Lost the rally shake it off
Return to base don't cough
Split step at the moment of contact
That's the move that's the pact

[Bridge]
Listo listo cada punto
Ready stance the simple grunto
Breathe deep paddle home
The ready chair the ready throne

[Chorus]
Ready position reset
Paddle high knees bent the safest bet
Breath in breath out no regret
Ready position reset

[Outro]
Return to ready every time
That's the foundation that's the rhyme
